_doc: STATUS-jas item 38 step 2: the two Layers-row ops the tree's row template needs and no op layer had.
cycle_element_visibility {path}: the eye button's cycle, preview -> outline -> invisible -> preview, on the
element at path only (a container's descendants inherit it when drawn; nothing is written onto them),
and an element that becomes invisible leaves the selection with its descendants.
set_element_name {path, name}: the rename commit; an empty name clears the name (the row then shows
<TypeLabel>). Both are one undoable transaction each, through Document.cycling_element_visibility and
Document.naming_element in all three op layers. Expected files are the reference's output, read against
the setup before commit; the no-op cases reuse lock_toggle_noop_expected.json (two_rects.svg unchanged).
name: cycling_a_leaf_once_makes_it_outline

_doc: Three cycles return to preview: the cycle is a cycle, and the document is exactly the setup.
name: cycling_three_times_is_a_round_trip

_doc: Cycling a LAYER writes the layer's own visibility and nothing onto its children; a selected child leaves the selection when the layer becomes invisible.
name: a_layer_made_invisible_drops_its_selected_child

_doc: The control for the case above: an outline layer keeps its selected child.
name: an_outline_layer_keeps_its_selected_child

_doc: An empty name clears it: naming then clearing is the setup again.
name: an_empty_name_clears_the_name

_doc: Each op is its own undo step: undoing the second rename leaves the first.
name: a_rename_is_one_undo_step

_doc: set_element_visibility {path, visibility} (the solo verb, item 8): sets the element's OWN visibility. Outline on [0,1] is the state one eye cycle reaches, so it is pinned to the cycle case's file.
name: setting_a_leaf_to_outline_matches_one_cycle

_doc: Setting a layer invisible drops its selected child from the selection, the same law as the eye cycle reaching invisible; pinned to that case's file.
name: setting_a_layer_invisible_drops_its_selected_child

_doc: Setting a layer to outline keeps its selected child; pinned to the cycle case's file.
name: setting_a_layer_to_outline_keeps_its_selected_child

_doc: Setting an element to the visibility it already has changes nothing.
name: setting_the_current_visibility_is_a_no_op

_doc: Invisible, then preview again: the element is back where it started (the solo restore's shape).
name: setting_invisible_then_preview_is_a_round_trip

_doc: Setting a leaf invisible hides that leaf alone, its sibling untouched: the state a Layers solo of [0,0] leaves [0,1] in (solo_element_visibility's action case pins to this file). Generated by the reference's op layer and read against the setup.
name: setting_a_leaf_invisible_hides_it_alone
